Right hinge side remains spatially fixed; left edge moved toward the left jamb.
Wardrobe door remains the same wood wardrobe with matching grain, perspective, hinges, and brass knob.
Current large visible head and torso are no longer exposed; they are covered by the opaque door.

No geometry, lighting, or texture changes outside the masked region.

prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: do not change unrelated objects, room layout, camera perspective, lighting direction, text, watermark
prompt_bundle.review_prompt: Check that the wardrobe door is now almost closed with a remaining vertical black slit roughly 18–25 px wide. Confirm the right hinge side remains fixed and the door still matches the original wood grain, knob, perspective, and lighting. Confirm that only tiny fragments of the pig mask are visible through the slit: a bit of one ear, one eye through an eye hole, and a thin snout edge, with no full face visible. Confirm the interior is near-black and any body visibility is limited to a barely perceptible emaciated neck/clavicle/rib hint or less. Confirm all pixels outside the masked wardrobe region are unchanged.

instructions: Use the current image as the exact spatial and lighting reference.
Constrain generation strictly to the provided edit mask.
Do not reinterpret the room, wardrobe placement, camera angle, or architecture.
Favor minimal-delta inpainting over creative regeneration.
Door motion must read as rotation around the right hinge side, not a sliding panel or reshaped wardrobe.

risk_flags: Narrow 18–25 px slit may be difficult for some models to respect precisely.
Model may over-reveal the figure unless negative constraints are enforced strongly.
Model may slightly alter door grain or knob placement during inpainting.
Potential safety-policy sensitivity around horror body depiction; keep body mostly hidden and non-graphic.
